name: finish
description: Signal task completion with a reason. Use when the task is finished or cannot proceed further. Note that you will need a separate turn to finish.

parameters.description: Same shape as stirrup.tools.finish.FinishParams, with ``paths`` coercion.

paths.description: List of file paths created or modified. Do not include directories, only files.
paths.title: Paths

parameters.title: CoercingFinishParams

name: abandon_task_finish
description: Signal that you do not believe the task can be completed, with a brief reason, instead of submitting files. Use only when required inputs are missing, a hard dependency is unavailable, or the request is incoherent. Do not use it to escape difficulty. Note that you will need a separate turn to finish.

parameters.description: Early-exit finish tool: abandon the task without submitting deliverables.

reason.description: Brief reason the task cannot be completed.
reason.title: Reason

parameters.title: AbandonFinishParams
